$comment: AEP-0006 / AEP-0002 §5.3: type-dependent capture gating for attention.answered.answer.values. A string-typed field's value — and an `other` free-text value on a select field — is user-authored text (redacted minimum, like answer.text); number/boolean/closed-select values are structural ids/primitives and survive at metadata. Each case: field_spec list + full values + the ceiling the emitter is gating for + the exact values object that must come out. Free-text sample values are deliberately redaction-neutral so both runners can assert exact equality (the §9.4 text-pipeline behavior has its own corpus in fixtures/redaction/).

cases.name: metadata ceiling drops free text, keeps structural (the asymmetry)
redacted ceiling keeps everything (free text through the pipeline)
closed single-select id is structural at metadata
other free text on a select is dropped at metadata even though a choice id would survive
none ceiling drops even structural values (values object empties, not leaks)
cases.$comment: values gating is field-level within data; at ceiling none the whole data object is already gone (AEP-0001 §8.2 downlevel drops data wholesale) — this case pins that gateFormValues itself only implements the metadata/redacted asymmetry and structural values pass, the envelope-level drop being the caller's job

cases.name: keys without a matching field_spec are dropped (conservative)
